automation.notes:
Use button: consume it for Dark Energon. Automatic: while you hold at least 1 Dark Energon, +1 Toughness and Evasion on the sheet and ↑1 on Strength and Speed Skill Tests, labelled Dark Energon (held) in the Roll Options Dialog. A switch there spends it for Edge, and each use adds to an addiction check that can give you Addicted.

Left to the table: its reroll option.
